flows.title: Download a report of your activity
steps: Select the report that suits you.
Follow the prompts to create and generate the report. A large report can take time to prepare, and PayPal emails you when it is ready.
When the report is ready, click Download.

flows.title: Download a monthly statement
steps: Click Request next to the month you want.
When the statement is ready, click Download.

flows.title: Add or change an email address
steps: In the Emails section, click +Add to add a new email address, enter it and click Confirm. PayPal sends a message to that address to confirm it.
To update an existing address, click Edit next to it.
To remove one, click the three dots next to it and select Delete. The primary email address cannot be edited or deleted until another address is set as primary.
